violations.why: After enable_isr(1) at line 43 the ISR can fire before the read at line 44 (garnet was still 1). It then writes v_willow between the two task reads.
The ISR can run during idlerun at line 47 or after enable_isr at line 51. It sets garnet to 0 and writes v_willow between the reads at lines 44 and 52.
The ISR can run between the reads at lines 38 and 52, for example during idlerun at line 39 or 47. It writes v_willow, and it also makes the garnet==0 condition at line 49 true.
